items.title: Water Quality Monitoring
items.description: Track pH, chlorine, alkalinity, and temperature in real-time with precision sensors.

items.title: Automated Alerts

items.title: Analytics Dashboard

items.title: Chemical Balancing

items.title: Maintenance Scheduling

items.title: Mobile Control
items.description: Manage everything from anywhere with our intuitive mobile app.

howItWorks.title: Up and Running in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to smarter pool management.

steps.title: Install the Sensor
steps.description: Place the AquaSense sensor in your pool. It takes less than 5 minutes — no tools required.

steps.title: Connect the App
steps.description: Download the app and pair your sensor via Bluetooth. Your dashboard populates instantly.

steps.title: Sit Back & Relax
steps.description: Receive real-time insights, automated alerts, and maintenance recommendations.
